text: dsh-vision-plugin 是面向 DSH Web 客户端的视觉能力插件：它注册 describe_image 工具，并在设置页配置 OpenAI 兼容的外部视觉模型。主模型可提交图片路径和问题，插件读取 PNG、JPG、WebP 或 GIF 图片，将图片与提示发送给所选视觉模型，再把文字描述返回给主模型。设置页支持加载模型列表、保存或清除 URL、模型和凭据。适合需要让纯文本模型理解截图、照片、图表或界面内容的 DSH 用户；需要自行配置图像模型端点，API Key 可填写。

dsh-vision-plugin adds image understanding to DSH Web. Its describe_image tool sends an image and optional question to a vision model, then returns a text description. A settings page lets users choose a model and manage the endpoint and credential. Supports PNG, JPG, WebP, and GIF.

I need to ask questions about an image file during a DSH conversation
dsh-vision-plugin 的功能「图片文字描述」：主模型调用 describe_image 并提供图片路径，可附上具体问题；工具读取支持格式的图片并把模型返回的文字描述交回对话。
dsh-vision-plugin 的功能「视觉模型设置」：在 Web 设置页填写 OpenAI 兼容端点和 API Key，加载并选择模型后保存配置，也可清除配置。
dsh-vision-plugin 的功能「识别图片格式并读取」：describe_image 根据文件扩展名处理 PNG、JPG、JPEG、WebP 和 GIF，读取工作区图片并将其作为图像附件提交给视觉模型。
dsh-vision-plugin 使用前须知：调用时会将所选图片及提示发送到配置的外部视觉模型端点；请先确认该服务适合处理这些图片内容。

[中文](README.zh.md) | English

Adds **image understanding** to [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (DSH): wire up an OpenAI-compatible external vision model, and a text-only main model (e.g. deepseek) can call the `describe_image` tool to hand an image to it and get a **plain-text description** — understanding screenshots, photos, charts, OCR, UIs, and more.
@woyeshishen/dsh-vision-plugin README · dsh-vision-plugin：> Design: **images go only to the secondary model (external vision model); the main model always deals with text.**

@woyeshishen/dsh-vision-plugin README · Features：| | |
| --- | --- |
| 🖼️ **Image understanding** | The main model calls `describe_image` and gets a plain-text description |
| ⚙️ **GUI configuration** | Fill in URL / API key / model on a settings page — no config files to edit |
| 🔒 **Secure credentials** | API key stored in the credential store, never echoed |
| 📦 **Install once, keep working** | Auto-loads at DSH startup, survives restarts |

@woyeshishen/dsh-vision-plugin README · One-liner (recommended)：**Windows (PowerShell)**

```powershell
irm https://raw.githubusercontent.com/woyeshishen/dsh-vision-plugin/main/scripts/install.ps1 | iex
```

**macOS / Linux**

```sh
bash <(curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/woyeshishen/dsh-vision-plugin/main/scripts/install.sh)
```

@woyeshishen/dsh-vision-plugin README · dsh plugin command：**From npm**

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add @woyeshishen/dsh-vision-plugin
```

**From GitHub**

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:woyeshishen/dsh-vision-plugin
```

After install, the plugin auto-mounts into the profile; restart DSH (or hot-reload) to activate.

@woyeshishen/dsh-vision-plugin README · Step 1: Configure the external vision model：Open **Settings → Multimodal Vision**:

| Field | Description |
| --- | --- |
| URL (Base URL) | OpenAI-compatible endpoint, e.g. `https://api.example.com/v1` |
| API key | Secret for the external model (stored encrypted, never echoed) |
| Model | Click "Load models" to fetch and pick from the endpoint |

Click **Save**.
